QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] Save the Sultan
QuestInfo.1: Jano asks you to infiltrate the palace and administer the antidote to the Sultan. From there, everything should work itself out on its own...
QuestInfo.2: When the Sultan took the antidote, he was able to see Areda for who she truly was. The Sand Bandits suppressed the Red Scorpions that had been occupying the palace. Areda was chased out, and peace returned to Ariant.
QuestInfo.0: The Sand Bandits find out the truth about Areda. You need to free the Sultan from the Mandraky potion's grasp, chase Areda out, and liberate Ariant!
